passes.shake:
Redraw the supplied first 4x4 green fortune-shake animation atlas in the actual animation-cel style of reference 2 (the leaping Neco-Arc). Reference 3 is the existing ArcPet idle sprite for identity and standing proportions. FIRST IMAGE is the exact timing, posing, placement, and reliable 16-cell layout reference; use it as a storyboard, style of first image is what must change. Redraw complete bodies and objects as one character in each frame. 
ART DIRECTION: Compare directly with reference 2. Use fine, quiet warm-gray/brown hairline ink contours, around 0.8–1.15 px at ~313px tile, variable pressure, with the finest interior strokes mostly replaced by a simple color-block boundary. No heavy dark outer stroke, no thick eyelid/lip stroke, no black sticker outline. Pale warm ginger-beige hair base (#f6d6ad), one flat dusty reddish cocoa shadow (#b48674), a few sharp buttercream highlight shapes, angular interlocking and layered tufts. Face and paws warm ivory peach (#fee7d2) with flat muted blush-toned shadow (#cc9a98) only on shaded underside, not blush on cheeks. Matte white simple shirt with one cel-gray fold shadow, blue skirt #485673 with navy #29334c solid-shadow planes, charcoal-black opaque tights #252529 contrasting visibly with short cocoa brown boots #55453d. Small relaxed closed eyes, drawn with two short fine curves, and small cat mouth. Tail pale gold with a single clear cocoa shadow ribbon. No gradient, airbrush, glowing highlight, textured skin/hair, or frosty white fleck. Preserve head size and geometry in all cels. Keep the same feet footprint, boot width, wrist/sleeve connections and neck, skirt and tail placement.
PROP: All THREE slips are absolutely IDENTICAL plain pale bamboo, single material tan #f4d4a4 with a subtle same side plane for each, same width, same straight clean rectangular construction with gently rounded tips. Completely BLANK: erase all red tips, bands, lines, symbols, paint, lettering, engravings, and color variations between sticks. No fourth slip. Only their exposure above the rim and lean change. Preserve the distinct smooth up/down shift drawn in source (left high in frames 4–5, middle high in 7–9, right high in 11–13); stems always seated in the same three slots of the open terracotta cup. Close both eyes and hold the cup with two attached paws throughout.
TECHNICAL: 4 columns x 4 rows EXACT same grid at 1254x1254 or as close as possible. Full complete sprites with margins per cell, planted boots at same floor, no labels/shadows/props besides the cup and slips. Chroma key solid bright RGB 0,234,33 green across canvas. Keep 16 sequential poses, no change of scale per image. No watermark. Finite motion cels, left and right following the original arc.
passes.draw:
Create a carefully redrawn 4x4 animation atlas for the DRAW and OPEN EYES phase of ArcPet Neco-Arc. Input 1 is the exact storyboard and frame registration. Input 2 is the revised SHAKE sequence: match its new matte palette, no-stamp light tan bamboo, thin brown-gray line weight, tresses and soft warm flat shading. Input 3 is the official character style reference. Image 1 has old heavy contours and a red marking that MUST BE REMOVED in all frames. Draw every frame as a complete body with costume, two attached arms, tail and props. 
Use EXACT same scale and costume as input 2, simple clean thin slate-brown outlines, few flat cel-shadow shapes, no sketch lines or airbrushed gradients, dusty cool muted head shadows, lighter straw-golden bangs, warm ivory peach skin, white top and cool dark blue skirt, BLACK opaque tights plus short warm muted brown boots with same footprint. Same closed eye curves & small cat mouth as input 2. In final row open eyes progressively into ample white ovals with deep red slit pupils matching reference 3. Red pupils are fine, NO RED WHATSOEVER ON ANY STICK. Cup matte muted terracotta with an oval rim, exactly the same width and height as shake cup, steady position until end. The three slips (including the one lifted out and the other two in the cup) are all the same matte light tan bamboo, completely blank, no caps, dye, dark marks, rings, lettering, bands, dots or identifying color. Uniform width.
Exact 16 cels in 4 equally spaced rows and columns. Row 1 match timeline of input 1: (1) eyes closed, both paws holding cup and three slips inside, directly match first cell of ref 2; (2) left paw begins lift near left rim; (3) closes in on leftmost stick; (4) firmly grasps stick, still in rim. Row 2: raising the exact same stick upwards 5 pixels at a time, through mouth of cup until it detaches from rim in cell (8). Keep grip clear and both other sticks visible inside the cup. Row 3: same blank stick remains in paw; smoothly display beside screen-left cheek while left elbow bends. Closed eyes. Row 4: the same settled pose, fully drawn each time, eyelids open a fraction each cell until both clearly fully open. Same hair mass, skull, seams, boots, tail in every frame. Strict 4x4 16 drawings, completely flat solid chroma green background, no shading on ground, border, labels, or text. All boots planted and colors/line treatment continuous from reference 2.
